check_date.description: Check one date in one country and get three plain answers: is it a holiday, is it a weekend day, is it a working day. Use it to gate a workflow on whether an office is open, or to decide whether to send something today. Only Public holidays count as a day off unless you say otherwise, and anything else marked on the date is reported separately rather than silently dropped.

description: Look up public holidays for over 200 countries from a workflow. List a country's holidays for a year or for a date range, get the next one coming up, check whether a particular date, or today, is a holiday, count the working days between two dates with weekends and holidays taken out, find the long weekends a year holds, and see every country's holidays for the week ahead. Holidays that apply only in a state or region are handled properly, so choosing California or Bavaria gives the calendar someone there really keeps. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
